name: Apprentice's Short Sword
description: A short blade for a crowded yard. The first lesson is stamped inside the guard — leave your neighbour room to draw.

name: Apprentice's Long Sword
description: The point bears a spot of blue paint. A recruit who came home with it still blue bought supper for the yard.

name: Apprentice's Dagger
description: A thumb-sized nick marks the safe end of the blade in the dark. The armourer adds it before handing over a first dagger.

name: Apprentice's Axe
description: The haft smells faintly of split pine. Between drills the recruits earned their keep in the woodpile.

name: Apprentice's Mace
description: A plain iron head with one polished face. The smith used it to ring the dinner plate before it found a soldier.

name: Apprentice's Spear
description: The lower half of the shaft is painted white so a master can see when a pupil's hands creep too close together.

name: Apprentice's Greatsword
description: A leather patch halfway up the blade marks where a second hand can safely take hold during drills.

name: Apprentice's Greataxe
description: The axe head carries a carpenter's stamp. In a lean year the yard borrowed both steel and instructors from the shipwrights.

name: Apprentice's War Hammer
description: A plug of lead balances the head. It rattles just enough to betray the pupil who tries to sneak out before drill.

name: Apprentice's Flame Staff
description: The ferrule is black with soot. Apprentices begin by lighting the watch lamps, one wick at a time.

name: Apprentice's Frost Staff
description: A faint white ring circles the grain. The pupil who made it meant to cool a cup of tea and froze the saucer to the table.

name: Apprentice's Storm Wand
description: A copper wire runs from tip to grip. The master has wrapped the last finger's breadth in very thick wool.

name: Apprentice's Arcane Orb
description: Small bubbles crowd the glass. Apprentices count them to steady their breathing before their first lesson.

name: Apprentice's Round Shield
description: Bent willow beneath a rawhide rim. The bruises in its face all lean the same way, the signature of a left-handed instructor.

name: Apprentice's Tower Shield
description: Its bottom edge is cut flat. Two recruits can stand these side by side and practise holding the gate.

name: Wayfarer's Short Sword
description: Short enough to draw under a ferry awning. A loop in the pommel takes a cord. The ford has swallowed plenty of good steel.

name: Wayfarer's Long Sword
description: A groove in the scabbard once held a folded toll receipt. The blade travelled both banks even when its owner could not.

name: Wayfarer's Dagger
description: The spine has a shallow notch for cutting fishing line. On the river road, supper takes precedence over a clean blade.

name: Wayfarer's Axe
description: A wedge of river oak holds the head fast. Whoever fitted it used the same wood to mend a wheel farther down the road.

name: Wayfarer's Mace
description: A strip of faded tent cloth binds the grip. Pull it loose and three different camp colours show through.

name: Wayfarer's Spear
description: A brass shoe protects the butt from wet stone. Ferrymen know its hollow knock on the landing before they see the traveller.

name: Wayfarer's Greatsword
description: The crossguard folds close against the blade for packing. Its old canvas cover still carries a charcoal sketch of a mountain pass.

name: Wayfarer's Greataxe
description: Two holes in the haft let it ride lashed beneath a cart. The wheel has rubbed a bright crescent in the steel.

name: Wayfarer's War Hammer
description: One face is worn smooth from driving tent pegs. The other still bears the little stars of a smith's punch.

name: Wayfarer's Flame Staff
description: A tin sleeve shelters the ember at the tip. Its maker had crossed the ford in rain and remembered arriving without a fire.

name: Wayfarer's Frost Staff
description: A leather cup hangs beneath the head to catch the thaw. Even on a hot road, the first mouthful tastes of snow.

name: Wayfarer's Storm Wand
description: Its copper tip leans east. An old mend, says the seller, though nobody who has carried it through a storm believes him.

name: Wayfarer's Arcane Orb
description: Held up to daylight, the glass shows a little air pocket shaped like a boat. The ferryman who traded it swore there used to be two.

name: Wayfarer's Round Shield
description: A ferry token plugs a hole in the rim. It was cheaper than a rivet and has carried its owner rather farther.

name: Wayfarer's Tower Shield
description: Under the shoulder strap is a chalk list of river crossings. The last entry has a price but no place name.

name: Veteran's Short Sword
description: The guard has been filed down on one side. Its owner always drew from a chair, an old wound made standing a slow business.

name: Veteran's Long Sword
description: Three cuts score the grip, exactly a thumb apart. Set your hand there and the opening motion of Sword Strike follows almost of its own accord.

name: Veteran's Dagger
description: The edge is almost gone from sharpening. The initials near the tang remain deep enough to read by touch.

name: Veteran's Axe
description: Five hafts have fitted this head. Slivers of each are wedged inside the socket, including a pale piece from the old north gate.

name: Veteran's Mace
description: A folded pay chit cushions the head against the haft. The seal is intact, the soldier never collected that month's wages.

name: Veteran's Spear
description: The shaft has been shortened below the grip. Long after mustering out, its owner walked the towpath with it every morning.

name: Veteran's Greatsword
description: The guard bears two sets of initials. The second is a clumsy copy of the first, made by a much younger hand.

name: Veteran's Greataxe
description: A horseshoe nail pins the head in place. Under the smith's stamp is the date of the last cavalry muster.

name: Veteran's War Hammer
description: The striking face is chipped at one corner. The missing piece is still buried in a hinge on the far bank.

name: Veteran's Flame Staff
description: Beneath the charred bark there is a child's picture of a hearth. The soldier varnished over it before returning to the front.

name: Veteran's Frost Staff
description: The grip is lined with an old mitten. A neatly darned thumb sticks out below the binding.

name: Veteran's Storm Wand
description: Copper staples bridge a lightning split. Each staple bears the tiny hammer mark of a different repair shop.

name: Veteran's Arcane Orb
description: A hairline crack divides the glass. Two thumbprints meet across it where someone held it together until the resin set.

name: Veteran's Round Shield
description: Only the central boss is original. Each new plank has been cut to preserve a small painted bird beside the grip.

name: Veteran's Tower Shield
description: On the inside someone painted a window, complete with curtains. At night on watch it faced the one person it was meant for.

name: Basic Cloth Hood
description: A plain linen hood. A brass button fastens it beneath the chin, every recruit in the yard learns to sew that button back on.

name: Basic Cloth Robe
description: Cut from a single bolt of undyed cloth. The narrow blue stripe at the hem once told the quartermaster whose loom to pay.

name: Basic Cloth Gloves
description: The first two fingers have a second layer of linen, useful for turning hot lamp wicks in the practice hall.

name: Basic Cloth Trousers
description: Deep turn-ups at the ankles leave room for a year's growth. The tailor charged by the bolt and disliked wasting cloth.

name: Basic Cloth Shoes
description: A reed sole slips inside each shoe. When the reeds wear thin, the whole yard can hear a pupil coming.

name: Basic Leather Cap
description: Rain has dried in a dark band above the brow. Under it the hide is still the pale colour of the tannery yard.

name: Basic Leather Vest
description: The buckle is set to one side. A recruit can lie flat in this vest without feeling a lump of brass beneath the ribs.

name: Basic Leather Gloves
description: The fingertips are stained with harness oil. Stable duty came before weapons practice for most of the old watch.

name: Basic Leather Leggings
description: The knees are cut from a second hide. A scratched tally on the inside runs to six days of kneeling at the gate.

name: Basic Leather Boots
description: A broad heel and a square toe, both cut to fit the same cheap last. The left and right only took shape with wear.

name: Basic Plate Helm
description: Five pinholes pierce the brow. On muster day the gate watch threaded a sprig of river mint through them.

name: Basic Plate Cuirass
description: Hammer marks radiate from a shallow dent over the heart. A discarded practice plate became someone's first real cuirass.

name: Basic Plate Gauntlets
description: A leather thong joins the gauntlets for storage. Losing even one meant paying the armourer for the pair.

name: Basic Plate Greaves
description: Each greave bears half a maker's stamp. Stand to attention and the two halves make a little open gate.

name: Basic Plate Sabatons
description: Iron toes from the old gate armoury. A felt tongue beneath each plate keeps an entire watch from announcing the change of guard.

name: Trailworn Cloth Hood
description: A traveller has sewn a loop inside the hood for a dry twist of tinder. A few strands are still tucked there.

name: Trailworn Cloth Robe
description: The hem is the colour of river mud. Higher up, little squares cut from a dozen different inns' sheets cover the tears.

name: Trailworn Cloth Gloves
description: The seams face outward so they won't rub beneath pack straps. One cuff still holds the waxed needle that did the work.

name: Trailworn Cloth Trousers
description: The pockets are tied shut with string. Whoever crossed the ford in these had already lost something to the current.

name: Trailworn Cloth Shoes
description: Fine gravel has settled between the layers of sole. The red grains come from a road well beyond the hills.

name: Trailworn Leather Cap
description: Little cuts in the brim let it fold beneath a hood. A sprig of dried mint is pressed into the sweatband.

name: Trailworn Leather Vest
description: A ferry token on a cord doubles as the top button. Its stamped fare has gone out of date twice.

name: Trailworn Leather Gloves
description: The right palm is dark from a walking staff. The left has a pale patch exactly the width of a mule's leading rein.

name: Trailworn Leather Leggings
description: A braided cord replaces the original belt. The knots mark watering places a day's walk apart.

name: Trailworn Leather Boots
description: Small iron nails hold the heels together. One was driven in crooked, giving the tracks a nick any guide would recognise.

name: Trailworn Plate Helm
description: The plume socket holds a tightly rolled map. A plume, its owner decided, was a poor thing to carry through low branches.

name: Trailworn Plate Cuirass
description: There is a permanent crease where a pack strap crossed the breastplate. Someone polished the crease along with the steel.

name: Trailworn Plate Gauntlets
description: The thumb plates have been trimmed short enough to tie a knot. The reins of a balky mule taught their owner that lesson.

name: Trailworn Plate Greaves
description: Red clay has hardened beneath the knee plates. It flakes away everywhere except around two small, carefully scratched names.

name: Trailworn Plate Sabatons
description: The toe caps are scored straight across. A boatman made the marks with a file so the steel would grip a wet plank.

name: Tempered Cloth Hood
description: Silver thread lies hidden inside the brim. Hold it near the forge and a row of old mends glitters through the weave.

name: Tempered Cloth Robe
description: A dyer worked ash into the lining. After a hundred washings, a sleeve brushed against white paper still leaves a grey stroke.

name: Tempered Cloth Gloves
description: Each cuff is woven with its maker's own pattern of knots. The patterns differ. Two weavers finished this pair.

name: Tempered Cloth Trousers
description: The knee patches are cut on the bias. A long stride draws them taut like the cloth over a drum.

name: Tempered Cloth Shoes
description: The soles have been felted until a needle will barely pierce them. The cobbler signed the heels in chalk instead.

name: Tempered Leather Cap
description: The hide was stretched over a copper bowl to shape the crown. Its rim left a thin green circle around the brow.

name: Tempered Leather Vest
description: A double row of stitches follows the ribs. The waxed cord came from a sailmaker who charged by the fathom.

name: Tempered Leather Gloves
description: Lambskin lines the fingers. The palms are old bullhide. The tanner matched the grain so closely that the join can only be felt.

name: Tempered Leather Leggings
description: A pale stripe crosses each thigh where the tanning straps lay. No amount of polishing has ever darkened it.

name: Tempered Leather Boots
description: The heels are built from thin leaves of hide, each stamped with the year it was cut. A century fits beneath a thumb.

name: Tempered Plate Helm
description: A ripple of blue runs along the visor. The smith kept the first failed visor on the wall to match that colour on the second.

name: Tempered Plate Cuirass
description: The breastplate gives a clear note when tapped. In the armoury by the ford, the master tested each plate with his wedding ring.

name: Tempered Plate Gauntlets
description: The knuckle plates lie over one another like roof tiles. One has been lifted and replaced to shelter a tiny paper blessing.

name: Tempered Plate Greaves
description: The inside of each knee is polished bright by a thousand drills. Only the metal beneath the hinge keeps its temper-blue.

name: Tempered Plate Sabatons
description: The pointed toes once caught on a stair. Both tips have since been rounded, and the smith sent the watch captain the bill.

name: Copper Ring of Fortitude
description: A copper band flattened on one edge. A ditch digger wore it against a shovel handle until the two fitted together.

name: Copper Ring of Focus
description: There is a groove on the band just wide enough for a thumbnail. A pupil could trace it while reciting a difficult passage.

name: Copper Ring of Protection
description: The outer rim shows the dents of a small hammer. Each watch recruit struck it once before the ring passed to the next.

name: Copper Amulet of Life
description: A baby's milk tooth lies behind the copper grille. The cord has been lengthened more than once.

name: Copper Mage's Amulet
description: Ink has worked into the joints of this copper pendant. It once held down the corner of a manuscript in a draughty room.

name: Copper Elemental Necklace
description: Three copper beads hang together. One has been scorched, one frosted white, and one split neatly down the middle.

name: Silver Ring of Fortitude
description: A worn saw mark interrupts the silver. The smith cut it from a larger band to fit the hand of a convalescent soldier.

name: Silver Ring of Focus
description: A pinprick star is set inside the band. Its owner used it to find the start of an incantation counted on the fingers.

name: Silver Ring of Protection
description: A silver wire is wound twice around a sliver of dark oak. The wood came from a gate that held until morning.

name: Silver Amulet of Life
description: The locket contains a pressed flower and a slip marked “spring”. Whoever wrote it saw no need to add the year.

name: Silver Mage's Amulet
description: The pendant opens on a square of polished silver. A mage far from home used it to read letters written in mirror script.

name: Silver Elemental Necklace
description: The three links nearest the clasp are different colours. Each was repaired by a smith who worked with a different flame.

name: Gold Ring of Fortitude
description: An old crown was beaten flat and bent around a finger. Part of the king's ear is still visible beneath the setting.

name: Gold Ring of Focus
description: A tiny lens rests in the bezel. It brings one letter at a time into focus, enough to read a spell in candlelight.

name: Gold Ring of Protection
description: Its seal depicts the gate before the river took the east tower. Only the oldest wax impressions still show both towers.

name: Gold Amulet of Life
description: Behind the gold lid is a lock of silver hair. The hinge has been repaired with the pin from a cradle bell.

name: Gold Mage's Amulet
description: A line of minute script runs around the bezel. There is just room for the final word beneath the maker's mark.

name: Gold Elemental Necklace
description: Three stones sit in gold cups. The jeweller left one cup loose so the stones would strike a soft chord as the wearer walked.

name: Minor Health Potion
description: Restores 50 HP. A thumb of red cordial in a thick glass vial. The infirmary gives the bottles to children once they are empty.

name: Health Potion
description: Restores 150 HP. A bitter red draught. The mint tied beneath the cork is for afterwards.

name: Greater Health Potion
description: Restores 400 HP. The glass is wrapped in linen so a shaking hand can still pull the stopper.

name: Minor Mana Potion
description: Restores 30 MP. The blue sediment settles before the walk from the apothecary to the bridge is over. Shake well.

name: Mana Potion
description: Restores 90 MP. In daylight it is almost clear. By lamplight a blue thread turns slowly through the bottle.

name: Greater Mana Potion
description: Restores 240 MP. The cork is sealed with three rings of wax. Old scribes break them with a penknife.

name: Minor Energy Potion
description: Restores 25 energy. Sour enough to bring tears to the eyes. The night ferry keeps half a dozen under the tiller.

name: Energy Potion
description: Restores 75 energy. A little ginger clings to the bottom. The runners on the ridge road insist on chewing it.

name: Bandage
description: Restores 100 HP over 10 seconds. Taking damage interrupts bandaging. The outer turn bears the laundry mark of the gate infirmary.

name: Antidote
description: Removes poison. The measuring line is deep enough to feel in the dark.

name: Hemostatic Tincture
description: Stops bleeding. The cork stains everything it touches a stubborn rust-red.

name: Scroll of Cleansing
description: Removes a curse. The words are spaced far apart so a trembling reader can keep their place.

name: Bread
description: Restores 100 HP over 20 seconds out of combat. The baker scores each loaf into four shares before it goes in the oven.

name: Fresh Water
description: Restores 80 MP over 20 seconds out of combat. A willow bung keeps this flask from rolling off a ferry bench.

name: Meat Stew
description: Restores 150 HP and 100 MP over 20 seconds out of combat. There is always an extra ladle in the pot for the watch coming off duty.

name: Scroll of Recall
description: Returns you to your bound location after a 5-second cast. Taking damage interrupts it. The blank at the foot is for the name of home.

name: Scroll of Resurrection
description: Revives an ally with 20% HP out of combat. The final line has room for a name in another hand.

name: Fire Bomb
description: Deals 60 fire damage in a 2.5 m radius. Its wick is braided in red so it can be told from a frost bomb by lantern light.

name: Frost Bomb
description: Deals 40 cold damage in a 2.5 m radius and slows targets by 20% for 3 seconds. The bottle crackles softly against a warm palm.

name: Elixir of Fire Resistance
description: Grants 10 fire resistance for 60 seconds. Another dose refreshes the duration. The glassblower's mark has melted into the neck.

name: Elixir of Cold Resistance
description: Grants 10 cold resistance for 60 seconds. Another dose refreshes the duration. A wool scrap tied to the flask once matched a ferryman's coat.

name: Elixir of Lightning Resistance
description: Grants 10 lightning resistance for 60 seconds. Another dose refreshes the duration. The wire round the cork is black at both ends.

name: Iron Ore
description: Iron for the smelter. A streak of red follows the seam, miners at the ford call it the hill's handwriting.

name: Copper Ore
description: Green-blue flecks give away the copper beneath the rock. The first handful from a new seam traditionally goes to the bellmaker.

name: Silver Ore
description: A thin vein of silver catches the light even under a film of mud. Prospectors wet the stone before naming their price.

name: Iron Ingot
description: A bar of smelted iron for weapons and plate. Its end bears three punch marks from the weigh-house by the ford.

name: Steel Ingot
description: Steel for reinforced gear. The smith clipped one corner to test the grain, the break is clean as torn sugar.

name: Copper Ingot
description: Enough copper for a handful of rings. One side is green where the ingot lay against a damp cellar wall.

name: Silver Ingot
description: Silver for a jeweller's bench. The narrow groove along its back lets the jeweller cut an honest share.

name: Timber
description: Straight timber for shafts and handles. A black knot at one end shows which way the tree leaned over the road.

name: Hardwood
description: Close-grained wood prized for staves and shields. Even the offcuts make a remarkably clear sound when struck together.

name: Raw Hide
description: The edges have been pegged out to dry. A missing peg let one corner curl into a hard little fist.

name: Tanned Leather
description: Leather ready for cutting into armour. A faint smell of oak bark survives the long bath in the tanner's pit.

name: Tough Leather
description: The thickest hide is saved for straps and reinforced seams. A saddler's awl has barely marked this piece.

name: Linen Cloth
description: Linen for padding and cloth armour. A blue thread marks the selvedge, the last work of a loom beside the old ford.

name: Silk
description: Fine silk for a mage's robe. It slips through a closed fist, leaving a single bright strand caught on the thumb.

name: Healing Herb
description: A red-veined herb used in health potions. Bruise a leaf and the scent will tell you where the infirmary gets its tea.

name: Moonflower
description: An ingredient in mana potions. The pale petals close at dawn, often around the fingers of the last picker in the field.

name: Empty Vial
description: Clean glass for an alchemist. The lip is thick on one side, a flaw that makes it surprisingly easy to pour from.

name: Coal
description: A hard lump of forge coal. The miners leave a stripe across each other's sleeves when they shake hands at the end of a shift.

name: Arcane Dust
description: Fine powder for enchanting. It gathers in the grooves of a fingerprint and sits there like stars on a chart.

name: Crystal Shard
description: A shard for an artificer's bench. Look along the broken face and every flaw becomes a little six-sided room.

name: Ember of the Ancient Flame
description: Ash closes over the ember whenever someone tries to count its sparks. The oldest hearth in the valley has one coal missing.

name: Heart of the Glacier
description: Clear ice around a single trapped bubble. Hold it level and the bubble drifts towards the high pass, however warm the room.

name: Storm Shard
description: A fork of black glass from the ridge. All the shepherds remember the lightning, none remember hearing thunder.

name: Guardian's Seal
description: The seal shows a hand closing a gate. In its oldest impressions there used to be a second hand on the other side.

name: Spirit Mirror
description: A silver backing gives this mirror a cloudy edge. Wipe it clean and the mist returns in the shape of a small breath.

name: Root of Life
description: A length of root curled round a stone. In the hollow between them lies a seed with its first green leaf still folded.

name: Void Crystal
description: The crystal casts a shadow towards the lamp. The cloth it came wrapped in has been darned over the same spot six times.

name: Seeker's Compass
description: A compass with a pencilled message behind the dial — “When you find the road, come back for me.” The pencil has outlasted the needle.

name: Elder's Letter
description: For the garrison captain. The elder folded the letter before the ink was dry. The words “east bank” have printed twice.

name: Bandit Insignia
description: Proof of the bandits' presence on the river road. Their badge was cut from a watchman's buckle and filed almost smooth.

name: Forest Wolf Fang
description: A forest wolf's fang for the hunter. A worn notch near the root matches the bite marks on his old horn.

name: Blighted Root
description: The healer asked for the whole root, soil and all. Black threads run through the cut end and into the earth still clinging to it.

name: Old Mine Key
description: The wards fit the old mine gate. A tally of shifts is scratched into the bow. The last marks are much closer together.

name: Ancient Map Fragment
description: The archaeologist's missing strip of map. Line up the banks of the river and a road appears where the water runs today.

name: Lost Medallion
description: A settlement keepsake. Open the locket and a small painted dog looks up at you, one ear still unfinished.

name: Sealed Parcel
description: The merchant's name is on the outer wrapper. Under it, faintly visible, is an earlier address in the same street.

name: Stone Guardian Heart
description: Proof that the stone guardian fell. The cavity in its centre is shaped for a bell, complete with a groove for the rope.

name: Forgotten Temple Relic
description: A clay votive from the forgotten temple. Beneath the soot on its base is the thumbprint of the child who made it.

name: Broken Blade
description: A blade broken just above the guard. The smith's stamp survived, which gives the scrap buyer something to bargain over.

name: Worn Pelt
description: A thin pelt with a bald patch down the spine. There is still enough fur along the edges to line a pair of mittens.

name: Cracked Stone
description: A pocket stone split clean through. Its two faces show halves of the same little fern.

name: Copper Trinket
description: A copper bird from a market stall. Its feet are polished bright from years of standing on a windowsill.

name: Empty Pouch
description: The drawstring is fine new cord, the pouch itself is worn through. Someone thought it worth mending one last time.

name: Old Coin
description: A collector's coin from the old ferry toll. The square hole once let the keeper string a day's crossings on a reed.

name: Trial Token
description: A token of entry for the current trial. The tally keeper cuts a fresh notch in the rim for every gathering.

name: Dungeon Run Key
description: A key issued for this dungeon run. The stamped number tells the porter which hook to leave empty until the party returns.

name: Arena Banner
description: The arena's prize banner for this match. The pole is worn smooth at the height of a runner's outstretched hand.

name: Unstable Crystal
description: A crystal gathered for the current event. The loose grit in its wrapping is all that remains of yesterday's sample.
